SRDatalog - Nim Wrapper for SRDatalog Runtime

This module provides the main entry point for using SRDatalog from Nim. SRDatalog is a high-performance Datalog engine with support for generalized semirings, enabling provenance tracking, probabilistic reasoning, and other advanced Datalog features.

Overview

SRDatalog combines:

  • Nim's expressive syntax: Write Datalog programs using a clean DSL
  • C++ runtime performance: Generated code uses optimized C++ data structures
  • Generalized semirings: Support for Boolean, probabilistic, and custom semirings
  • Column-oriented storage: Efficient SoA (Structure of Arrays) layout
  • HashTrie indexing: Fast multi-level indexes for efficient joins

Quick Start

See the example programs in src/example/ for complete working examples:

  • triangle.nim: Non-recursive multi-way join query
  • tc.nim: Recursive transitive closure using fixpoint rules

Basic usage:

import srdatalog/lang

srdatalog_prelude()

# Define database schema
datalog_db MyDB:
  Edge: Relation[int, int]
  Path: Relation[int, int]

# Define base case (non-recursive)
none_recursive_rule BaseCase:
  [{(Path x y)} <-- {(Edge x y)}] {. name: Base order: [x, y] .}

# Define recursive case (fixpoint)
fixpoint_rule TransitiveClosure:
  [{(Path x z)} <-- {(Path x y) (Edge y z)}] {. name: TC order: [y, x, z] .}

# Create database with memory arenas
var arena_full = newArena()
var arena_delta = newArena()
var arena_newt = newArena()
{.emit: "SemiNaiveDatabase<MyDB> db(&`arena_full`, &`arena_delta`, &`arena_newt`);".}

# Add facts
edb db:
  (Edge ($"BooleanSR::one()") ($"1") ($"2"))
  (Edge ($"BooleanSR::one()") ($"2") ($"3"))

Architecture

The Nim wrapper uses compile-time code generation:

  1. Macro Expansion: Nim macros parse Datalog syntax
  2. AST Generation: Creates an abstract syntax tree
  3. C++ Code Generation: Emits optimized C++ code using {.emit.}
  4. Runtime Execution: C++ runtime executes the generated code

This hybrid approach gives you:

  • Type safety at compile time (Nim)
  • Runtime performance (C++)
  • Clean, declarative syntax (Datalog DSL)

See also

  • srdatalog/lang for the main language macros
  • For C++ runtime documentation, see generalized_datalog/relation_col.h
